answer: Written in a skeptical lens, addresses failure modes first register, it stays short. The design leans on game-theoretic equilibrium in agent coordination. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the echo of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the beacon of a task receipt, and the ripple is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
